o1: Predicted to enable K63-linked polyubiquitin modification-dependent protein binding activity, cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity, and thiol-dependent deubiquitinase activity. Is involved in positive regulation of microtubule severing during mitosis. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human OTUD7A (OTU deubiquitinase 7A) and OTUD7B (OTU deubiquitinase 7B).
